fullPassage: In technological design, an aspiration towards seamlessness aims to make the technological experience for humans blend seamlessly into our everyday lives. Essentially, this aspiration aims towards experiences where people are no longer (a) aware of the technology, the interface or the differences between human-technology and human-human interaction. Considering the metaphor of seams in clothing, we can say that we aspire to seamless aesthetics by stitching the seams closely, pressing them flat and making sure they are (b) hidden on the inside so that we wear clothing rather than pieces of fabric. When designers and engineers talk about technological seamlessness, they are often referring to ease of use and convenience. For example, in interface design, an aspiration towards seamlessness (c) ensures the experience for the user flows and is not stressful or irritating. Most of us would have had experiences of (d) poor interface designs or apps in workplaces that make things more complicated and irritating, and have longed for more seamless interfaces. Technological seamlessness can also include less visible screens in new technologies, or virtual reality technologies with a seamless technological design. The aim is to immerse the user experience such that the visual interaction might be described as inside the screen rather than a body interacting with a digital console or object as separate entities. Similarly, seamlessness in humanoid robotic design aims to make humanoids (e) distinguishable from a human body.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ① blend: make + O + V원형(사역동사) — 정상
❌ ③ referring: are + -ing (진행형) — 정상
❌ ④ immerse: to + V원형 (to부정사) — 정상
det.tip: by + -ing: ~함으로써. by stitching(바느질함으로써)

✅ ① where: 관계부사 — 정상

✅ ④ such that: 결과 접속사 — 정상

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 기술 디자인에서 매끄러움은 기술을 더 눈에 띄게 만드는 것을 목표로 한다.
옷의 솔기를 안쪽에 숨기는 비유를 통해 매끄러운 미학을 설명한다.
디자이너들은 기술적 매끄러움보다 기술의 복잡성을 중시한다.
매끄러운 디자인은 솔기를 바깥에 드러내는 것이다.

det.korean: ② 원문: 솔기를 안쪽에 숨겨(hidden on the inside) 매끄러운 미학 설명 — 일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 일치: 솔기를 안쪽에 숨기는 비유
❌ ① 불일치: blend seamlessly = 눈에 안 띄게
❌ ③ 불일치: 복잡성이 아닌 편의성 중시
❌ ④ 불일치: 바깥이 아닌 안쪽에 숨김
det.tip: hidden on the inside = 안쪽에 숨김. 매끄러운 미학의 핵심

ch: 디자이너들이 기술적 매끄러움을 말할 때 사용 편의성을 지칭한다.
대부분의 사람들은 부실한 인터페이스를 경험한 적이 있다.
기술적 매끄러움은 새 기술에서 더 큰 화면을 포함한다.
사람들은 더 매끄러운 인터페이스를 갈망해 왔다.

det.korean: ③ 불일치: 원문은 'less visible screens'이지 '더 큰 화면' 아님.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 불일치: less visible(덜 보이는)이지 larger(더 큰) 아님
❌ ① 일치: ease of use and convenience
❌ ② 일치: experiences of poor interface designs
❌ ④ 일치: longed for more seamless interfaces
det.tip: less visible screens ≠ 더 큰 화면. 숫자/정도 변조 주의

Similarly, seamlessness in humanoid robotic design aims to make humanoids indistinguishable from a human body.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 시각적 상호작용은 화면 밖에서 이루어지는 것이 목표이다.
매끄러운 디자인은 몸과 콘솔을 별개로 유지하는 것이 목표이다.
휴머노이드 로봇은 인간과 확실히 구별되도록 설계된다.
매끄러운 로봇 디자인은 휴머노이드를 인간과 구별 불가능하게 만드는 것을 목표로 한다.

det.korean: ④ 원문: 'make humanoids indistinguishable from a human body' — 일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 일치: 구별 불가능하게 만드는 것이 목표
❌ ① 불일치: inside the screen(화면 안)이 목표
❌ ② 불일치: 별개가 아닌 통합이 목표
❌ ③ 불일치: indistinguishable(구별 불가)이 원문
det.tip: indistinguishable from = 구별할 수 없는. distinguishable = 구별할 수 있는 (42번 정답)

questions.passage: In technological design, an aspiration towards seamlessness aims to make the technological experience for humans blend seamlessly into our everyday lives. Essentially, this aspiration aims towards experiences where people are no longer aware of the technology, the interface or the differences between human-technology and human-human interaction.
questions.stem:
위 글에서 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 찾아 쓰시오.

"이 열망은 사람들이 기술과 인간 사이의 차이점을 인식하지 못하는 경험을 목표로 하며, 기술이 일상에 매끄럽게 __________ 되는 것을 추구한다."

det.korean: 기술이 일상에 blend(어우러지다) 되는 것을 추구한다.
det.analysis: 원문 'blend seamlessly into our everyday lives'에서 blend를 찾아 씀.
det.tip: blend into = ~에 자연스럽게 녹아들다, 어우러지다

questions.passage: Similarly, seamlessness in humanoid robotic design aims to make humanoids ____________________ from a human body. The aim is to immerse the user experience such that the visual interaction might be described as inside the screen rather than a body interacting with a digital console or object as separate entities.
questions.stem:
위 글에서 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 찾아 쓰시오.

"매끄러운 로봇 디자인은 휴머노이드를 인간의 몸과 __________ 만드는 것을 목표로 한다."

det.korean: 휴머노이드를 인간과 구별 불가능하게(indistinguishable) 만드는 것이 목표.
det.analysis: 원문 'make humanoids indistinguishable from a human body'에서 indistinguishable을 찾아 씀.
det.tip: indistinguishable from = ~과 구별할 수 없는

questions.passage: In technological design, an aspiration towards seamlessness aims to make the technological experience for humans blend seamlessly into our everyday lives. Essentially, __________. Considering the metaphor of seams in clothing, we can say that we aspire to seamless aesthetics.
questions.stem:

[ this / aspiration / towards / aims / experiences / where / people / are / no longer / aware / of / the technology ]

This aspiration aims towards experiences where people are no longer aware of the technology

det.korean: 이 열망은 사람들이 기술을 인식하지 못하는 경험을 목표로 한다: this aspiration aims towards experiences where people are no longer aware of the technology.
det.analysis: this aspiration(주어) + aims towards(동사) + experiences(목적어) + where(관계부사) + people are no longer aware of the technology(관계절)
det.tip: aim towards = ~을 목표로 하다. where = 관계부사(experiences 수식)

questions.passage: In technological design, an aspiration towards seamlessness aims to make the technological experience for humans blend seamlessly into our everyday lives. Essentially, this aspiration aims towards experiences where people are no longer (a) aware of the technology, the interface or the differences between human-technology and human-human interaction. Considering the metaphor of seams in clothing, we can say that we aspire to seamless aesthetics by stitching the seams closely, pressing them flat and making sure they are (b) hidden on the inside so that we wear clothing rather than pieces of fabric. When designers and engineers talk about technological seamlessness, they are often referring to ease of use and convenience. For example, in interface design, an aspiration towards seamlessness (c) ensures the experience for the user flows and is not stressful or irritating. Most of us would have had experiences of (d) poor interface designs or apps in workplaces that make things more complicated and irritating, and have longed for more seamless interfaces. Technological seamlessness can also include less visible screens in new technologies, or virtual reality technologies with a seamless technological design. The aim is to immerse the user experience such that the visual interaction might be described as inside the screen rather than a body interacting with a digital console or object as separate entities. Similarly, seamlessness in humanoid robotic design aims to make humanoids (e) distinguishable from a human body.
questions.stem:
다음 한국어를 영어로 완성하시오.

"우리는 솔기를 꼼꼼히 바느질함으로써 매끄러운 미학을 추구한다."

→ We aspire to seamless aesthetics __________ the seams closely.

det.korean: 바느질함으로써: by + -ing = by stitching.
det.analysis: by + -ing: ~함으로써. by stitching the seams closely = 솔기를 꼼꼼히 바느질함으로써.
det.tip: by + -ing: 수단/방법을 나타내는 전치사구

다음 한국어를 영어로 완성하시오.

"휴머노이드 로봇 디자인에서의 매끄러움은 인간과 구별할 수 없게 만드는 것을 목표로 한다."

→ Seamlessness in humanoid robotic design aims to make humanoids __________ a human body.

det.analysis: make + O + C: make humanoids indistinguishable from = 구별 불가능하게 만들다. from은 비교 대상 표시.
